notes.title: Version 1.5.2 patch notes
notes.notes:
Bug fixes
Fixed an issue where players using Simplified or Traditional Chinese would be reset to English upon restarting the game. Clearly not the intended behavior! (thanks to Shroom_香菇 for reporting this issue to us on Discord)
Miscellaneous
 Update sub menu title label to reduce confusion. In the "Play" menu where you select to play online or local, we've renamed "New Run" back to simply "Play" in every language.  

 Fix typos in "The Dark Chest" description (thanks to Wrecked... for reporting this issue to us on the Steam Forums).

notes.title: Version 1.5.1 patch notes
notes.notes:
Bug fixes

 Fix issue causing a cutscene soft-lock when Barnaby and Alphy were unlocked at the same time when returning to The Great Lighthouse after a run (thanks to TheUnBearable and Matan for reporting this issue to us on Discord).
 Add a missing pew pew mode sound during Claws, Tyrant of The Deep boss fight. The missing sound goes like this: *CHAK CHAK* (but it sounds better in-game than by text).
 Tentatively fix the "ghost" enemy bug in online multiplayer, where enemies appeared invincible to the client and stayed on screen for the rest of the run. Please report on Discord if the issue persists!

Miscellaneous

 Update main menu button labels to reduce confusion. With the recent addition of the run progression save feature, we introduced a new "Continue" button that lets players resume an unfinished run. Previously, the buttons were labeled "Resume Run" and "New Run", which led some players to believe "New Run" would reset their save file. To address this, we've renamed "New Run" back to simply "Play" in every language.
 Adjust translations in other languages for the "Resume Run" button text.
 Fix typos in new dialogues texts.
 Lower the popshell explosion volume in pewpew mode.

notes.title: Ship of Fools — Alphy's project update out now!
notes.notes:
Hey Fools! Developer Dan here to officially announce the biggest makeover the Archipelago has ever seen! As of today, you’ll be able to meet Alphy and Pelly in your adventures to turn your starting area into the coziest nest a pelican holding a shrimp could ever dream of. 

[previewyoutube=L2_HOkavJHg;full][/previewyoutube]
[hr][/hr]
Alphy's project begins
Just like other major island dwellers, Alphy and Pelly are first found stranded on a raft in the middle of the sea… but this time, reaching them won’t be so easy.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42083281/b75e1b469cc3c95383ec9dbef35d84cf9a8607a3.gif

To find them, you’ll need to dust off the trusty Stormstrider with [spoiler]the Beacon unlocked[/spoiler] and head into the Darkness. Only then will you have a shot at rescuing these new (and very handy) allies.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42083281/a5720f697516b9364bef69a60f6e8bc42df266b4.gif

Once rescued, you’ll start seeing Alphy and Pelly on the islands you visit during runs. Hand them extra items and resources you don't need, and they’ll use them as materials to rebuild the many structures of the Great Lighthouse—your new and improved starting hub!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42083281/f686b25f265882b8da59619a4520c1da98680456.gif

While Alphy is busy with construction, Pelly is laying eggs of the most unconventional properties that can alter reality itself.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42083281/5ca769197e12c1950bc9742b15b4361a180d82be.png

Pew Pew Mode is real!!
Pelly’s first-ever egg, the Pew Pew Egg, does something truly unhinged:

It replaces every. single. sound effect. in the game… With mouth-crafted masterpieces.

Yes, you heard that right. Over 400+ sound effects and 32 complete songs have been remade a cappella by our very own Ship of Fools dev team. What started as an April Fool’s joke in 2023 has now become a fully realized (and completely ridiculous) feature, thanks to the incredible talent of our composer, Philippe Grant, and the sheer foolishness of our team.

We're curious to find out what will be your new favourite pew pew mode remastered song!

Electric Effect

As Alphy and Pelly work on rebuilding your base, you’ll start receiving rewards from grateful inhabitants as a token of their appreciation.

For instance, once Rust’s Forge is fully restored, she’ll reward you with your very own gunsmith hammer, a new item called the Thunderclap (that will now be permanently added to your item pool). The Thunderclap introduces a brand-new elemental effect: the Electric Effect!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42083281/63c9fac199bbda2cd5b9a4d36de029c2e77b2c74.png

When an electric imbued projectile hits an enemy, it unleashes a burst of five electric bolts that have pierce and homing effects. Even better: these bolts inherit any effects currently active on the Fool who caused the electric effect to trigger—creating chaotic, chain-reactive moments of brilliance.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42083281/dd762278b7a70a5c8a4fcd0ae693efcd072475da.gif

Many more items and space-time altering eggs are yet to be discovered!
[hr][/hr]
Four New Fools Join the Fray!

Alongside this free content update, 2 new Packs of  Fools are released as DLC! The first pack is the Golden Bay Duo introducing Commodore Goldie and Hanha!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42083281/0201551510affeed97f2fce4c2d17be2f0b42992.jpg

Both these characters bring a new gameplay mechanic, allowing them to spend Sand Dollars to overcharge their reflect action, unleashing game-changing abilities!

Commodore Goldie – Flaunts its wealth with pride, yet hides a heart of gold

 A goldfish with a taste for riches, Goldie digs with her trusty shovel to uncover Whirl Pearls. (or, with a bit of luck, maybe something else?)
 On impact, these pearls create a Cash Vortex, scattering gold and wealth as they strike enemies!


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42083281/dbd2d6c40cf9027bf870f57be3aeb48dbae7a2c1.gif

Hanha – Relentlessly tracks the weak, leaving no bounty unclaimed

 A fearsome bounty hunter, Hanha marks an enemy for the hunt.
 When a marked foe is defeated, they drop a Hunting Trophy into the water—trinkets that boost player stats!
 Each enemy has its own unique trophy, making every battle a high-stakes hunt! We will let you discover what each individual trinket does! Happy hunting!


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42083281/2f0ed6510d580bb105a4c8c82948cb681d766460.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42083281/7ec5ee64ead464a9646f22f3592b84f9285df3f8.gif

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3547520/Ship_of_Fools__Golden_Bay_Duo
[hr][/hr]
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42083281/4aecd6d67644f315dad55cbdaac9728534d3a01e.jpg

Prepare to unleash shocking new strategies with The Thunder Tide Duo! This electrifying Pack of Fools introduces two eccentric new characters—mad scientists of high Aquademic renown who harness the power of static electricity to zap their foes into the bottomless abyss!

Both characters utilize a new gameplay mechanic that lets them roll to generate static charges. These charges build up and release into increasingly powerful electric effects!

Eelvis – Shock and Roll!

 An amped-up electric eel with a jolted stage presence.
 When he fires a cannon, he discharges all stored static energy, creating a devastating electric explosion on impact!


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42083281/4b358b6cee8ec3f8858b8162314b7431c8231592.gif

Gastropaul – Heavy shell, strong personality

 This sea snail might look slow, but his resilience experiments make him a defensive powerhouse.
 If Gastropaul gets knocked down or stunned, he shrugs it off and instead unleashes an electric explosion, fueled by his stored charges!


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42083281/b6277134a96c330e8e532e883f6d495c91023d8b.gif

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3547530/Ship_of_Fools__Thunder_Tide_Duo

[hr][/hr]
Completely Foolish Edition
Alongside these new changes to the game, we’re introducing a new bundle that contains the base game, soundtrack and the 4 packs of fools for a grand total of 18 playable characters!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42083281/612c495b46694615992815d752a7176b0ae9a8eb.jpg
[hr][/hr]
v1.5.0 patch notes
New features:

 New NPC Alphy now available to get rescued in the Darkness sector
 Alphy's quest introducing new items, new game modifiers as well as repairing broken structures in the starting area
 Resume an unfinished run in local and online (also works for both solo and coop!)
 New Electric elemental effect
 [spoiler]Repaired fountain acts now as a wishing well to sink excess tendrils[/spoiler]


Miscellaneous:

 Electric effect added to the random effects that Siren scale and Coral could produce.
 Allow player to skip the end of run reward sequence by pressing the interact button an additional time.
 Add many Tendril Chest reward tiles in The Darkness sector map generation
 [spoiler]New happier starting area ambiance and music once everything is repaired[/spoiler]


Bug Fixes:

 Fix DLC announcement’s highlight in the main menu not displaying when selected.
 Fix possible soft-lock happening in the main menu when accidentally creating another online game in the background.
 Fix map storm counter sometimes showing negative values.
 Fix trinkets effects being removed twice in some cases (mostly in local coop) when switching fools, causing the players to have multiple negative stats Reported by a bunch of people : Biosense on Steam, Wyzard, zote and undergrinder on Discord, T_Pog, Peatchi, SSLYK on reddit
 Fix save being deleted in some cases when the file was locked. It will now retry for 5 seconds and close the game if the save file is present but cannot be read. Reported on discord by Christianxox1
 Betty unlock condition not being tracked correctly in online play Reported by Old_rosie on reddit
 Fix sentry sometimes not shooting Reported on discord by Katfield and Dean
 Fix item with long names could not be fully visible in inventory
 Fix storm progression starting from tiles that were previously stormed after using the beacon
 Fix Light Toolbox trinket should not be available when using the Red Scourge. Reported Professional_Denizen on reddit
 Fix add cooldown when playing a specific sound to prevent the same sound being played a lot in a short period of time
 Fix an issue preventing the prompt telling to pick up the cannon in the tutorial to show up
 Fix issues caused by starting a run with only the second player connected

[hr][/hr]
Wallpapers
Always liked our Keyarts? You can now bring the Fools to your desktop with a new selection of free wallpapers from Ship of Fools!

Download the free Ship of Fools wallpapers from the game file location shown below, or by visiting this website [ https://www.team17.com/ship-of-fools-wallpapers ]!

Steam > steamapps > common > Ship of Fools > Wallpapers

Come aboard!
I hope this small showcase gave you enough to jump back in!
Join us on Discord, to give some feedback, talk with the devs and report bugs!

notes.notes:
Hey Fools! Developer Dan here, back at it again, because my evil plan I shared with you on April 1st worked! You heard that right, Ship of Fools is officially getting a new FREE content update, and oh boy what an update it is!

Mark your maps! Alphy’s Project Update launches on Steam on April 24th, 2025!

In this post, I’ll introduce you to some of the exciting new features coming your way, including four brand-new fools available as DLC!

Alphy’s project

Hold and behold Pelly and Alphy! The ultimate partners in crime (and construction)! These two have landed in the Archipelago with a grand mission: restoring every broken structure to its former glory!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42083281/8057c07367fca56d5b0d9aa9cba08f99dd673eed.png

Your job? Gather materials on your journey and bring them back to The Great Lighthouse Island so Alphy can unlock powerful new items and… well… Pelly?

Pelly, on the other hand, will be laying eggs—but not just any ordinary eggs! These eggs hold space-time-altering properties, adding an extra layer of foolishness to your adventure once incubating!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42083281/6d73b56ed19267f0bc056b2a7cc39d7e37626a4b.png

Each egg introduces a unique, togglable game modifier, because who doesn’t love absolute chaos? And here is the first one!

It replaces every. single. sound effect. in the game… With mouth-crafted masterpieces.

What started as an April Fool’s joke in 2023 has now become a fully realized (and completely ridiculous) feature, thanks to the incredible talent of our composer, Philippe Grant, and the sheer foolishness of our team.

In case you’ve missed it back then, here was the original April Fools skit that started the idea for the pew pew mode:

[previewyoutube=Xo_Dtbw6hRE;full][/previewyoutube]

One of the most requested quality of life features is finally here!

With this update, you’ll finally be able to save your progress mid-adventure!

How does it work?

 Your progress auto-saves whenever you select a new encounter on the map.
 Next time you return, you can resume your adventure right where you left off!
 Want to switch things up? You can continue a solo run in co-op or even take an offline game online—your run stays intact and it works the other way around too!

notes.title: Endless mode update out Now! Also Orcs?
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42083281/f588090851b9999f2e7a42553230adb09faa34c2.png

Wait what? Orcs? Those guys can swim now?

Before talking about the latest Ship of Fools update, let us introduce Don’t Kill Them All, our brand new game being revealed on Kickstarter TODAY! 

It would mean the world to us if you show your appreciation for our work by backing our next game! You can also wishlist it now on Steam to stay in the loop. We’ve put a lot of care into it and we’re sure you’ll like it a lot!

To back our project on Kickstarter

To watch the trailer on Youtube

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42083281/c82faf765e1d763bba8b22eeef349d96eb2d8a55.png

Hey Fools! Developer Dan here, bringing you details about this new Ship of Fools update releasing the highly anticipated endless mode along with a plethora of balance adjustments and bug fixes.

Since the game's launch, the community has eagerly requested an endless mode, allowing a successful run to continue indefinitely. So we did it! From now on, upon winning any run, you'll have the option to embark on an Endless Mode adventure, retaining your current equipment and starting anew from The Forgotten Waters.

But beware! Each time you enter a new loop, enemies receive a substantial power boost. This added challenge compounds with the modifiers provided by The Lighthouse brightness levels.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42083281/601eb7c7045e21ec529a9e392c441904476635eb.png

Hold on a moment... Are we suggesting that it's now feasible to duplicate any item at the High Sea’s fountain on each loop? This would theoretically allow for an infinite number of identical trinkets to be equipped simultaneously, right?

YES.

Let the crazy builds go wild and shall the fun remain endless!

v1.4.0 patch notes
New features:

Endless mode added

Balance changes:

 Reduce owlet movement speed when charging the boat before exploding
 Increase paper plane ammunition homing force and damage

Fools balance changes:

 Quill: Missing a shot only removes 2 stacks instead of all of them. Sentry gun not hitting enemies does not count as a miss. We felt that her ability was too punishing, making her almost unplayable in certain situations. Now Quill is a strong pick while still requiring some good aiming!
 Betty: Initiate rage mode when getting hit by a regular paddle attack from another player instead of only initiating from a heavy hit. This allows for the other player to continuously initiate Betty’s rage mode while she remains shooting!
 Finley: Rework reward pool from repairs. Now when repairing, Finley has a chance of spawning:

 Regular resource: 60%
 Basic chest: 25%
 Ancient chest containing an item: 5%

 Jules: All light trinkets are now included in the pool of obtainable items from his ability. Jules will now generate a trinket when defeating The Eye of the Storm. Prior to this update, activating Jules' ability upon defeating the final boss was unnecessary. However, with the introduction of Endless mode, this item now serves a purpose in subsequent loops!

Miscellaneous:

 Prevent sentry cannons from shooting an enemy with an active deflection bubble
 Barnaby and Jules ability now remove the generated item from the pool of obtainable items to make sure those items are not generated again in the same run
 Replace Mama Gull inventory image
 Replace Yoyo trinket activation keyword from “damage” to “accuracy”
 Something special added to the main menu…

Bug Fixes:

 Fix plank bundle given by the siren in The Edge cave sometimes falling in the water
 Fix achievements for completing a run not being shared with the client in an online game
 Fix some special chest encounters ending too soon
 Fix siren ship misplaced hole making it hard to repair
 Fix enemies looping sound never stopped in certain situations
 Fix projectile attack ground target sometimes not being deactivated
 Fix item transfering when switching fools not working properly as the client in an online game
 Fix paddle reach bonuses given not applied to the client in an online game
 Fix homing projectiles not being able to hit enemies that are very close to the water level
 Fix Mama Gull projectiles not hitting some boss parts
 Fix sometimes being able to open the map during sector loading soft-locking the game

notes.title: Fish & Ships update and Water Garden Duo DLC out now!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42083281/31832c762303a9dee6d76fd56d45030f73573ad2.gif

Developer Dan here to celebrate the official release of Ship of Fools’ brand new content update: Fish & Ships! Aaaaandd (drumroll) … the release of our brand new pack of Fools: the Water Garden Duo! Watch this trailer!

[previewyoutube=Oxoao2beYRE;full]https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Oxoao2beYRE[/previewyoutube]
This new update brings a ton to the archipelago! Let’s go over some of the most notable new features.

Give the curious bell a jingle to meet your new gooey and tentacley best friend Otto, a shipwright with enough tools to repair your ships, but most importantly, mend the wounds of your broken heart.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42083281/0d991dca38ff86be564a685b2b624933024f48ed.gif

You’ll first be introduced to Otto when you have beaten Tentacles twice or if you’ve completed a run at least once. Unlike his other fellow Krakens, Otto is more passionate about ship construction rather than their destruction.

The process is simple: after unlocking a new ship, interact with Otto using your character's secondary action to access the shipwright menu. From there, you have the freedom to switch between any unlocked ships at will. You can also monitor your progress towards unlocking new ships and achieving the brightness challenges for each one. I'm curious about the outcome when reaching brightness level 15 with a ship … I wonder what awaits?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42083281/7708a562b27c52308d9d3e2734eedcf8f6164294.gif

Each ship grants access to 2 unique items, allowing you to craft run strategies with a refreshing sea breeze. To activate their abilities, every ship's unique artifact utilizes Tendrils.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42083281/94887b6033804e48f6108ee3fac8bcf1e07f96de.gif

Speaking of new ships, here is one of them! Meet the Siren’s Call, a vessel carved by the legendary Sirens from the same rocks that constitute their magical artifacts. With the Siren’s Call, you’ll have one less pedestal on deck, but have access to a miniature version of the recycling well to optimize your builds on the go!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42083281/089c59eab6b1f9630e489db4ad247325712f8ca9.png

The Well
Insert a tendril to activate, once active, insert any item to recycle it into another of the same type.

Siren Scale
While this ammunition inflicts minimal damage, it applies a random effect with each hit! To unleash its full potential, you’ll need to harness every possible elemental synergy.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42083281/92f7fce2da01af1a02c14b6e47563f6c57d11339.gif

May this latest content update bring many more adventuring hours for you and your shipmate across the archipelago's waters! A heartfelt thank you to each member of the Fool community for your unwavering support throughout this inaugural year of Ship of Fools. Our game dev journey has been nothing short of wonderful, and we hope to keep sailing with you all for a long time! If you're inclined to support the dev team in a meaningful way, please consider diving into the all-new Pack of Fools, a creation inspired by the captivating charm of your local water garden.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42083281/2af9cd175080462a3c20c3150ea80570adab9827.png

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2512030/Ship_of_Fools__Water_Garden_Duo/

notes.title: Ship of Fools Pricing Update
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42083281/28f343563ed067e1fd471145d63be15aafe4e266.png

Hey Fools! Developer Dan here to give you updates on what’s to come for Ship of Fools and its next content update: Fish & Ships!

Important announcement regarding pricing 

We've got some important news to share with all of you, and we want to ensure you understand our decision's reasoning. At Fika, our commitment has always been to deliver the ultimate Ship of Fools experience, and we've poured our hearts and countless hours into achieving that goal. Over the past year, we've continuously released free content to make our game the best it can be.

Now, after careful consideration and extensive discussions, we've concluded that our game has evolved to a point where it deserves a price that truly reflects the dedication and hard work we've invested. 

Starting from October 6th, we will be adjusting the price of Ship of Fools from $14.99 to $21.99 USD / €14.99 to €21.99. Regional equivalents and console pricing may vary.

We understand that change can be unsettling, especially for our early adopters who have been with us from the beginning. But please rest assured that we have your best interests at heart. We are committed to ensuring that you, our fans, are not impacted in any way by this price adjustment. The upcoming Fish and Ships update is still free of charge and to make this as smooth as possible, we’ve announced this in advance while the game is on sale, so you have the perfect opportunity to go and purchase Ship of Fools now if you haven’t yet or pick up a copy for a friend.

Thank you for being a part of this incredible journey, and we can't wait to see you on board as we sail into the future of Ship of Fools.

Fish & Ships SPOILER ALERT!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42083281/63b2963c62c81ee6f88f606bb3028acb04612ea8.gif

Now it’s time for some EXCITING news! Fish & Ships is around the corner, and Stormstrider’s time is over! Let me introduce you to the Wavehulk!

The Wavehulk is a masterpiece of engineering, and it’s the first new boat provided by Otto the shipwright. With its upgraded hull, you’ll be able to carry one additional cargo at the expense of a less optimized pedestal placement.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42083281/c3aef1194e72ccef6c4cfa4218d310935314709a.png

The Wavehulk comes equipped with 2 new unique items that synergize with each other and will shape many new run strategies.

The Foundry
The Foundry is a mystical device designed for converting trinkets into artifacts! Artifacts produced by The Foundry distribute the trinket’s power they hold to every player. Here's how it works:

Solo Play:

 When playing solo, The Foundry will transform 1 trinket into 2 artifacts. This sorcery is stronger than any of Halga’s soups.
 But keep in mind you need enough cargo space to place both artifacts on your pedestals.
Co-op Play:

 In co-op mode, the Foundry operates slightly differently. It simply transforms one trinket into an artifact.
 The exciting part here is that both players can enjoy the benefits of the trinket's power once it's transformed into an artifact.

So, whether sailing solo or with a crew, the Foundry is your go-to place for turning humble trinkets into mighty artifacts!

Metal Scraps
At first glance, metal scraps may not seem very impressive, but they can become quite powerful as you collect more artifacts for your boat! The Metal Scraps projectile gains an extra 2 damage for every artifact you have in play. So, the more artifacts you accumulate on your ship, the stronger those seemingly humble metal scraps become, packing a more significant punch!

Let’s see it in action!
Are you ready to get crazy! Here’s an example with a brand new trinket: Shuriken!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42083281/1a2531442525ceb4a2cac4d49c4b34034cebf667.png

In the same way The Beacon on the Stormstrider is activated, you first need to power up The Foundry using a Tendril.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42083281/99d80b9e426f16cb5430ce0a220ed14e92c411ac.gif

Once powered, take any trinket you want and place it inside The Foundry. Maybe some trinkets act differently once turned into artifacts… who knows?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42083281/bee7ca1ce5120758c60e1bdbe72a92a32564ddf7.gif

TA-DA! See those artifacts? They carry the same power as the trinket, but in artifact form benefiting every player. As you can see, in this case, the player goes solo and turns one Shuriken trinket into 2 Shuriken artifacts, allowing them to shoot 2 additional projectiles with each shot! Since those trinkets are now artifacts, it also increases the Metal Scraps' power! PRETTY COOL RIGHT?

There is a loot collector in all of us, and this boat perfectly fills this primal need. Will you go all-in on artifact tiles and become richer than Briny? Or you'll aim to be the trinket duplication kingpin, filling your ship with more bling than a disco ball. And let's not forget, with that shiny metal coating, you'll hit the fashion peaks no one even knew existed! The Wavehulk is like a buffet of build possibilities, and trust us, you won't leave hungry for adventure! 

There are many more items, boats and secrets to unveil in the Fish & Ships update. Let us know what you think so far! 

You've not got long to wait as all this new content will be coming to all platforms in November of this year.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42083281/8620bc6eee7b2b933bc7896841beb10cce0d28bb.png

Fools! Are you ready for a scoop? Developer Daniel here to share the utmost exciting announcement!

Mark your calendars for May 9th, the day when The Great Lighthouse update and The Deep Sea Duo DLC will be released on Steam! As previously mentioned for 2023, with every FREE major update, we'll offer a pack of two new characters for purchase to support your favourite hard-working devs!

Have you ever pondered what lies beneath the surface of the Archipelago? Well, we have and we ventured down there so you wouldn't have to. You would not believe it but we returned with these two magnificent beauties from the depths.

https://i.imgur.com/nTaaFLf.gif

Angus, the anglerfish, has a bright future, but a dark past… With a blinding lure, Angus applies a new special ability to perfectly reflected projectiles to transform them into homing torpedoes!

https://i.imgur.com/Y4uWn87.gif

Jules, the diver, thrives under pressure. Their collector’s magnet allows them to gain an additional trinket upon defeating a domain’s ruler. Jules is a character who will have a slower start than others, but a potentially devastating endgame.

https://i.imgur.com/9vsrWQi.gif

On the same day, The Great Lighthouse update will also be available for everyone! In this update, we crank up a notch the challenge for anyone who has beaten the game at least once. 

The Great Lighthouse will propose a total of 15 new difficulty tiers to unlock. In order to unlock a tier, you’ll have to complete the game with the previous tiers active and each time you’ll gain a reward that will add new exciting activities or items in the Archipelago! Spoiler alert, here are the first difficulty tiers and their rewards!

We still have a little more than a week to find a way to open the door of The Great Lighthouse, but bear with us, the lock is really hard to pick… 

In the meantime, we found this unusual-looking seagull that looks odd, but quite friendly. Weird.

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.0.2 - Ship Of Fools
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42083281/56fe495397635b7389dc4e0fd2a7f7370c19120d.png

Hey Fools! Developer Daniel here to bring you good news and a new update for Ship of Fools on Steam!

First of all, in the name of the whole Fika team, we want to thank each and every one of you for the amazing response we received since the release of the game. This is our first project and we are amazed to see how much you guys are enjoying what we’ve made and how Ship of Fools impacted people’s lives. We took the time to gather your thoughts and feedback to bring you a first balance and bug-fixing update that increases the quality of life and the overall stability of the game. 

This update does not bring any new content, but know that we are well aware that you guys want more of Ship of Fools and that it needs a few more challenges. Stay tuned with us to see what lurks beneath the Everlasting Storm’s thick clouds…

Bug Fixing: 

 Fixed issue causing some achievements to never unlock
 Fixed enemy kills achievements meter on steam not displaying player progress 
 Fixed inflated Puffy dealing no damage when exploding
 Fixed the issue causing The Dark Storm curse to not update the storm counter for the guest in an online game 
 Fixed issue disabling Betty’s rage mode ability in an online game
 Fixed trinkets shown in both inventories when players equip them at the same time in an online game
 Fixed issue causing Eye of the Storm to never reappear after vanishing thus soft-locking the players
 Fixed issue causing Eye of the Storm to sometimes place curses on previously placed ones
 Fixed credits volume not affected by sound preferences
 Fixed issue where game state could not be saved when buying upgrades (Thanks to discord user @Maximilien(Gringan) for reporting it)
 Fixed warrior statuette item could reload disabled cannons by The Dark Cannon curse (Thanks to discord user @HappyReaper for reporting it)

Quality of life: 

 Access options from Pause menu 
 Unlock the sentry cannon in the armoury when Rust is saved making it upgradable in the early game
 Multiple tutorial improvements making it easier for new players to pick up the game

Exploit removed: 

 Removed player ability to keep an item in their hands while travelling to a new destination
 Removed player's ability to overcharge the Grapeshot or the Powershot cannon in an online game
 Fixed reflected harpoons being able to unsocket artifacts without disabling their abilities making it possible to apply the same artifact ability multiple times (Thanks to discord user @RealGoose for reporting it)

Balancing:

 Increase Lotte ammo regeneration time
 Decrease Shellbie bonus stats given to loaded mags
 Reduce Assault, Grapeshot, Powershot and Double Barrel cannon fire rate
 Increased Sentry cannon fire rate
 Increased chance of multiple flyers initiating an attack at the same time when playing coop
